                    Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0),
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                    Text = tostring(optionValue),
                    TextColor3 = Theme.TextSoft,
                    TextSize = 10,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    ZIndex = 25,
                    Parent = option,
                })

                optionRows[tostring(optionValue)] = {
                    Row = option,
                    Left = left,
                    Label = label,
                }

                option.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    item:Set(optionValue,false)
                    item:Close()
                end)
            end

            refreshVisuals()
        end

        function item:Open()
            if open or not enabled then
                return
            end

            closeOtherPicker(item)
            Window._OpenPicker = item
            open = true
            optionsHolder.Visible = true
            arrow.Text = "^"

            local visibleRows = math.clamp(#values,1,6)
            local listHeight = visibleRows * 34 + 12
            optionsHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,listHeight)

            Tween(row,.17,{
                Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,closedHeight + listHeight + 10)
            })
            Tween(selectorStroke,.13,{Color=accent,Transparency=.40})
        end

        function item:Close()
            if not open then
                return
            end

            open = false
            if Window._OpenPicker == item then
                Window._OpenPicker = nil
            end

            arrow.Text = "v"
            Tween(row,.15,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,closedHeight)})
            Tween(selectorStroke,.13,{Color=Theme.StrokeSoft,Transparency=.72})

            task.delay(.15,function()
                if not open and optionsHolder.Parent then
                    optionsHolder.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end

        function item:Set(newValue,silent)
            local valid = false

            for _, optionValue in ipairs(values) do
                if tostring(optionValue) == tostring(newValue) then
                    newValue = optionValue
                    valid = true
                    break
                end
            end

            if not valid then
                return false
            end

            value = newValue
            refreshVisuals()

            if not silent and callback then
                task.spawn(callback,value)
            end

            return true
        end

        function item:Get()
            return value
        end

        function item:SetEnabled(newEnabled)
            enabled = newEnabled ~= false
            selector.BackgroundTransparency = enabled and .47 or .78
            valueLabel.TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or .50
            if not enabled then
                item:Close()
            end
        end

        function item:SetOptions(newValues,preserve)
            local oldValue = value
            values = copyArray(newValues)

            if preserve then
                local found = false
                for _, optionValue in ipairs(values) do
                    if tostring(optionValue) == tostring(oldValue) then
                        value = optionValue
                        found = true
                        break
                    end
                end

                if not found then
                    value = values[1]
                end
            else
                value = values[1]
            end

            buildOptions()
            refreshVisuals()
        end

        Overlay(selector,function()
            if open then
                item:Close()
            else
                item:Open()
            end
        end,30)

        buildOptions()
        Window.Items[key] = item
        return item
    end

    function Window:MultiSelect(parent, key, title, description, values, defaults, callback, options)
        options = options or {}
        values = copyArray(values)

        local closedHeight = 62
        local row = baseRow(parent,closedHeight)
        row.ClipsDescendants = true

        local accent = resolveAccent(options.Accent or "cyan")
        local selected = makeSet(defaults)
        local open = false
        local enabled = options.Enabled ~= false
        local item = {}

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,7),
            Size = UDim2.new(.46,-18,0,20),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = tostring(title or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,28),
            Size = UDim2.new(.46,-18,0,18),
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text = tostring(description or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        local selector = New("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-12,0,12),
            Size = UDim2.new(.50,0,0,36),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel3,
            BackgroundTransparency = .47,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })
        Round(selector,9)
        local selectorStroke = Stroke(selector,Theme.StrokeSoft,.72,1)

        local summary = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(11,0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-38,1,0),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = accent,
            TextSize = 10,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 19,
            Parent = selector,
        })

        local arrow = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-8,.5,0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22,22),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Text = "v",
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextSoft,
            TextSize = 10,
            ZIndex = 19,
            Parent = selector,
        })

        local menu = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel2,
            BackgroundTransparency = .16,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,closedHeight + 2),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,0),
            Visible = false,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 22,
            Parent = row,
        })
        Round(menu,10)
        Stroke(menu,accent,.62,1)

        local toolbar = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7,7),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-14,0,30),
            ZIndex = 23,
            Parent = menu,
        })

        local search = New("TextBox", {
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel3,
            BackgroundTransparency = .48,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-104,0,30),
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            PlaceholderText = options.SearchPlaceholder or "Search",
            PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            ZIndex = 24,
            Parent = toolbar,
        })
        Round(search,8)
        Stroke(search,Theme.StrokeSoft,.78,1)

        New("UIPadding", {
            PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,9),
            PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,9),
            Parent = search,
        })

        local allButton = New("TextButton", {
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundColor3 = accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = .85,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-98,0,0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(45,30),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = "ALL",
            TextColor3 = accent,
            TextSize = 8,
            ZIndex = 24,
            Parent = toolbar,
        })
        Round(allButton,8)
        Stroke(allButton,accent,.62,1)

        local clearButton = New("TextButton", {
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel3,
            BackgroundTransparency = .52,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-48,0,0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48,30),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = "CLEAR",
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextSoft,
            TextSize = 8,
            ZIndex = 24,
            Parent = toolbar,
        })
        Round(clearButton,8)
        Stroke(clearButton,Theme.StrokeSoft,.72,1)

        local list = New("ScrollingFrame", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7,43),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-14,1,-50),
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            ScrollBarThickness = 2,
            ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent,
            ZIndex = 23,
            Parent = menu,
        })

        New("UIListLayout", {
            Padding = UDim.new(0,4),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Parent = list,
        })

        local optionRows = {}
        item._Selector = selector
        item._Menu = menu

        local function emit()
            summary.Text = summarizeSelection(values,selected,options)

            if callback then
                task.spawn(
                    callback,
                    selectedList(values,selected),
                    selected
                )
            end
        end

        local function refreshSummary()
            summary.Text = summarizeSelection(values,selected,options)
        end

        local function refreshOptions()
            for optionValue, data in pairs(optionRows) do
                local on = selected[tostring(optionValue)] == true

                Tween(data.Row,.10,{
                    BackgroundTransparency = on and .52 or .87,
                })

                Tween(data.Left,.10,{
                    BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1,
                })

                data.Label.TextColor3 = on and Theme.Text or Theme.TextSoft
                data.State.Text = on and "ON" or ""
                data.State.TextColor3 = accent
            end
        end

        local function rebuild()
            for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end

            table.clear(optionRows)

            for index, optionValue in ipairs(values) do
                local option = New("TextButton", {
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel3,
                    BackgroundTransparency = .87,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Text = "",
                    Size = UDim2.new(1,-3,0,31),
                    LayoutOrder = index,
                    ZIndex = 24,
                    Parent = list,
                })
                Round(option,8)

                local left = New("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = accent,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0,5),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2,21),
                    ZIndex = 25,
                    Parent = option,
                })
                Round(left,999)

                local label = New("TextLabel", {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1,-55,1,0),
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                    Text = tostring(optionValue),
                    TextColor3 = Theme.TextSoft,
                    TextSize = 10,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                    ZIndex = 25,
                    Parent = option,
                })

                local state = New("TextLabel", {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1,-10,0,0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34,31),
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                    Text = "",
                    TextColor3 = accent,
                    TextSize = 8,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                    ZIndex = 25,
                    Parent = option,
                })

                optionRows[tostring(optionValue)] = {
                    Row = option,
                    Left = left,
                    Label = label,
                    State = state,
                }

                option.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
